$schema_note: Machine-readable Pano theme contract, generated from the controller/view split. Consumed by 'theme-core check' and store-side CI.

props.data: object — load result (posts, postCount, page, totalPage, category, categoryUrl, sidebar, hookProps) plus View
props.themeSettings: plain object — from getContext('themeSettings') in the controller; postsEnabled gates the post list and pagination
props.onPageClick: function(data, page) — pagination navigation handler imported from HomePageLogics

props.data: object — page data (initialError, pageTitle, View)
props.session: store — session context from getContext('session') (siteInfo, user, csrfToken)
props.email: writable store — register email field value
props.passwordRepeat: writable store — register password-repeat field value
props.agreement: writable store — register agreement checkbox value
props.newUsername: writable store — new username field value (SET_USERNAME state)
props.error: writable store — current error (string or {key, props})
props.passwordVisible: writable store — whether the password field is shown
props.emailRequired: writable store — backend requested a register email
props.autoVerifyDone: writable store — link code auto-verify already attempted
props.usernameRequiredUserId: writable store — user id pending username selection
props.onSubmit: function — submit the login / set-username form
props.onVerifyLink: function — verify the entered link code
props.onUsernameOrEmailFieldInput: function — input handler for the username/email field
props.onRegisterEmailFieldInput: function — input handler for the register email field
props.onNewUsernameFieldInput: function — input handler for the new username field

props.data: object — SvelteKit page data (initialError, initialUsername, pageTitle, View)
props.contentItems: store<Array> — plugin-extensible register page content items ({ id, priority, component }) from panoApiClient.ui.auth.register.content
props.altMethods: store<Array> — alternative registration methods injected by plugins
props.onSubmit: function — submits the register form (validation, session update, redirect)
props.loading: writable store<boolean> — true while the register request is in flight
props.error: writable store<string|null> — error key rendered by ErrorAlert
props.successMessage: writable store<string|null> — success key rendered by SuccessAlert
props.username: writable store<string> — two-way bound username field value
props.email: writable store<string> — two-way bound email field value
props.password: writable store<string> — two-way bound password field value
props.passwordRepeat: writable store<string> — two-way bound password confirmation value
props.agreement: writable store<boolean> — two-way bound register-agreement checkbox value

props.data: object — full load data (notifications, notificationCount, sidebar config), forwarded per recipe
props.notifications: store — currently loaded notification list (writable from init())
props.count: store — total notification count on the server
props.loadMoreLoading: store — true while the next page of notifications is fetching
props.checkTime: store — tick counter passed BARE (no $) to getTime so relative timestamps refresh
props.avatarVersion: store — cache-busting version appended to profile picture URLs
props.currentLanguage: store — active language object; .dateFnsCode selects the date-fns locale
props.locales: object — date-fns locale namespace (import * as locales stays in controller, passed as a plain value)
props.onNotificationClick: function — notification row click handler (from NotificationManager)
props.loadMore: function — fetches next page; markup calls it with the notifications and loadMoreLoading store objects
props.sanitizeObject: function — escapes notification detail values before {@html} i18n interpolation

props.data: PageData — SvelteKit load result; the markup reads data.registerDate (epoch timestamp of the player's registration, rendered via the Date component)
load data — post ({title, text, category, writer, thumbnailUrl, views, date}), previousPost/nextPost (object or "-"), hookProps, View
props.themeSettings: plain object (getContext("themeSettings") in controller) — post* visibility toggles read directly, not as a store
props.avatarVersion: store object (writable from $pano/lib/Store) — view auto-subscribes via $avatarVersion for profile-picture cache busting

props.data: object — full load result (post, previousPost, nextPost, View); passed per view contract, markup does not read it directly
props.post: object — the post being previewed (title, category.title, writer.username, text, date, views, thumbnailUrl); originates from the shim prop post={data.post}
props.themeSettings: object — getContext('themeSettings') resolved in the controller (postCoverImageEnabled, postViewCountEnabled)
props.avatarVersion: store — store object from $pano/lib/Store; view auto-subscribes as $avatarVersion for avatar cache-busting

props.data: object — page load data, forwarded verbatim to plugin ViewComponents
props.session: store — session context store; markup reads $session.siteInfo.supportEmail and .websiteName
props.items: store — plugin view entries registered for the 'support-content' slot (from panoApi.ui.view.get)
props.optionItems: store — plugin view entries registered for the 'support-options' slot (from panoApi.ui.view.get)

props.data: object — SvelteKit page data (data.token = activation token from URL, consumed by verifyEmail; data.View = resolved view class)
props.error: writable store — error code rendered by ErrorAlert (e.g. "INVALID_LINK"); passed as store object, view reads $error
props.successMessage: writable store — success code rendered by SuccessAlert ("VALIDATION_SUCCESSFUL")
props.loading: writable store — true while the verification request is in flight (spinner + disabled button)
props.activateContentItems: readable store — plugin-injected content items for the activate page (panoApiClient.ui.auth.activate.content.get())
props.verifyEmail: function(error, successMessage, loading, data) — runs the e-mail verification request; called from the button on:click with the raw store objects

props.data: object — merged load data (token, pageTitle, session, View, …)
props.activateNewEmailContentItems: store<item[]> — plugin-injected content items for the activate-new-email slot (from panoApiClient.ui.auth.activateNewEmail.content.get())
props.loading: writable store<boolean> — true while the activation request is in flight
props.error: writable store<string|null> — error code shown in ErrorAlert (e.g. "INVALID_LINK")
props.successMessage: writable store<string|null> — success code shown in SuccessAlert after activation
props.verifyEmail: function — (error, successMessage, loading, data) sends the email-activation request; markup passes the store objects themselves

props.data: object — page data from load; forwarded to onSubmit (also carries data.View)
props.error: writable store — error shown by ErrorAlert; set by onSubmit
props.message: writable store — success message shown by SuccessAlert; set by onSubmit
props.loading: writable store<boolean> — true while the change-password request is in flight; disables inputs/button
props.newPassword: writable store<string> — bound value of the new password input
props.newPasswordRepeat: writable store<string> — bound value of the repeat password input
props.renewPasswordContentItems: store<Array<{id, component}>> — plugin-injected content items from panoApiClient.ui.auth.renewPassword.content.get()
props.onSubmit: function — (error, message, loading, newPassword, newPasswordRepeat, data) form submit handler from RenewPasswordPageLogics

props.data: object — merged page data from $page.data (session, pageTitle, View); not read by the default markup but part of the view contract
props.error: writable store — error code rendered by ErrorAlert
props.message: writable store — success message code rendered by SuccessAlert
props.loading: writable store — true while the reset-password request is in flight
props.usernameOrEmail: writable store — bound value of the email/username input (view also calls .set() in oninput)
props.resetPasswordContentItems: readable store — plugin-registered content items rendered inside the form via ViewComponent
props.onSubmit: function(error, message, loading, usernameOrEmail) — logic import passed through; sends the reset-password request
props.stripIdentifierWhitespace: function(value) — logic import passed through; strips whitespace in the input's oninput handler

props.data: object|undefined — always undefined today (SvelteKit runs no load for +error.svelte); kept for the shared controller contract and forwarded as {data}
props.page: reactive object (store-like prop) — SvelteKit page state from $app/state; page.status selects the 404 vs internal-error subtitle

props.data: object — page data (themeSettings, View)

props.session: store — session context from getContext("session") (siteInfo: serverIp, websiteName, websiteDescription)
props.activeTab: writable store — selected settings tab id ("general", "logo", "header", ...)
props.saving: writable store — save request in-flight flag
props.resetting: writable store — tab reset in-flight flag
props.resettingAll: writable store — full reset in-flight flag
props.backgroundImageFiles: writable store — FileList of the picked page background image (bind:files)
props.headerBackgroundImageFiles: writable store — FileList of the picked header background image (bind:files)
props.playCardBackgroundImageFiles: writable store — FileList of the picked play-card background image (bind:files)
props.currentThemeDefault: writable store (derived via $:) — default navbar/header colors for the selected theme color
props.defaultHeaderBg: writable store (derived via $:) — whether the default header background is active
props.orderedNavLinks: writable store — nav links (native + plugin) in saved order
props.orderedFooterLinks: writable store — footer links (native + plugin) in saved order
props.draggingItemIndex: writable store — index of link row being dragged (or null)
props.dragOverItemIndex: writable store — index of link row dragged over (or null)
props.tabChanged: writable store (derived via $:) — active tab has unsaved changes
props.tabResetVisible: writable store (derived via $:) — reset-tab button visibility
props.allResetVisible: writable store (derived via $:) — reset-all button visibility
props.onThemeColorChange: function — theme color select handler (also applies default navbar/header colors)
props.onBackgroundImageChange: function — page background image file-input change handler
props.onRemoveBackgroundImageClick: function — remove the saved page background image
props.onHeaderBackgroundImageChange: function — header background image file-input change handler
props.onRemoveHeaderBackgroundImageClick: function — remove the saved header background image
props.onPlayCardBackgroundImageChange: function — play-card background image file-input change handler
props.onRemovePlayCardBackgroundImageClick: function — remove the saved play-card background image
props.onDragStart: function — dragstart handler for link reordering (event, index)
props.onDragOver: function — dragover handler for link reordering (event, index)
props.onDragEnd: function — dragend handler for link reordering
props.onDrop: function — drop handler for link reordering (event, index, "nav" | "footer")
props.toggleLink: function — enable/disable a navbar link (id, checked)
props.toggleFooterLink: function — enable/disable a footer link (id, checked)
props.save: function — save the active tab's settings
props.resetTab: function — reset the active tab's settings (with confirm modal)
props.resetAll: function — reset all theme settings (with confirm modal)

props.data: object — page data from load (registerDate, lastLoginDate, pageTitle, sidebar, View)
props.contentItems: store<Array> — plugin-extendable profile page content blocks from panoApiClient.ui.profile.content.get()
props.cardRowItems: store<Array> — plugin-extendable profile card table rows from panoApiClient.ui.profile.cardRows.get()

props.data: object — page data (sessions, sidebar, pageTitle, View)
props.session: store — session context from getContext("session") (siteInfo, user, csrfToken)
props.Languages: store — available UI languages keyed by id ({ code, name })
props.resetPasswordError: writable store — error key of the reset-password action

props.resetPasswordSuccess: writable store — reset-password link sent flag

props.newEmail: writable store — new email field value (change-email step 2)

props.saveButtonDisabled: derived store — whether the save button is disabled

props.registerPlugin: function — register/unregister a plugin row's save state
props.handleSave: function — save locale change + dirty plugin rows
props.logout: function — log out the current session (passed the session store)
props.showToast: function — show a toast notification (ToastContainer module export)
props.parseUserAgent: function — user-agent string to short browser label
props.stripIdentifierWhitespace: function — strip whitespace from identifier input

props.data: object — page load data (pageType, page, totalPage, ticketCount, category, categoryUrl, View)
props.contentItems: store — plugin-extendable content item list from panoApiClient.ui.tickets.content.get(); markup iterates $contentItems
props.tickets: store — tickets list store produced by init(data) in the controller; markup reads $tickets and hands the raw store back to onCloseTicketClick
props.PageTypes: object — ticket filter enum (ALL/CLOSED) from TicketsPageLogics, used for the header button active states
props.onCloseTicketClick: function — (ticketsStore, ticket) close-ticket handler from TicketsPageLogics

props.data: object — page data from load (ticket, messages, sidebar config); also carries View
props.ticket: store — the ticket being viewed (id, title, category, status, date, messageCount)
props.messages: store — currently loaded ticket messages, oldest first
props.message: store — current text of the reply textarea (bind:value={$message})
props.messageSendLoading: store — true while a reply is being sent
props.messagesSectionDiv: store — holds the message-list element, set via bind:this={$messagesSectionDiv}; logic scrolls it
props.loadMoreLoading: store — true while older messages are being fetched
props.shouldScroll: store — whether the message list should scroll down after sending
props.sentMessageCount: store — messages sent this session, offsets the 'previous messages' count
props.avatarVersion: store — cache-busting version appended to profile picture URLs
props.loadMore: function — fetches the previous page of messages (called with loadMoreLoading, messages, data)
props.sendMessage: function — sends the reply (called with messageSendLoading, sentMessageCount, shouldScroll, messages, message, data)

props.data: object — page load data (categories, sidebar, pageTitle, View)
props.error: writable store — submit error rendered by ErrorAlert
props.title: writable store — ticket title input value (bind:value={$title})
props.message: writable store — ticket message textarea value (bind:value={$message})
props.categoryId: writable store — selected category id, -1 = no category (bind:value={$categoryId})
props.loading: writable store — request in-flight flag, disables the submit button
props.submit: function — (error, loading, title, message, categoryId) sends the create-ticket request; view passes the store objects, not their values

props.data: object — full layout load data (session payload, _pageTitleStore, View); passed for contract completeness, unused by the stock view markup
props.session: store — writable session store ({ user, csrfToken, siteInfo }) returned by init(data); view reads $session.siteInfo for favicon hash and website name
props.pageTitle: store — current page title descriptor (null | i18n key string | { title, titleValues }); view reads $pageTitle for the document title
props.getTitle: function — (pageTitle, siteName) => formatted document <title> string; stays in the controller because it closes over the controller's $_ (svelte-i18n) subscription

props.data: object — controller load data (hookProps, View, mainLayoutView); unused by the default markup but kept for the view contract
props.themeSettings: object — the 'themeSettings' context object (theme color, header/navbar gap, footer & breadcrumb toggles, background/custom CSS settings)
props.session: store — the 'session' context store passed as a store object; view auto-subscribes via $session for the head meta tags

props.data: object — layout load data returned by processLoad (AuthLayoutLogics), plus View
object — layout load data from ProfileLayoutLogics.processLoad (includes data.View, the resolved view component)
object — merged layout load data from processLoad (ThemeSettingsLayoutLogics), also carries View; unused by the trivial markup but kept per contract
props.hidden: store<boolean> — store returned by ThemeSettingsLayoutLogics init(); drives the hidden attribute on the wrapper div

object — load result; data.registerAgreement: sanitized HTML of the register agreement

settings_tabs._note: Base ThemeSettingsPage tab → settings-key map, mirrored from the controller's baseTabKeys. A theme.config.js settingsSchema may APPEND keys/tabs; the checker uses this to reject a key that a theme puts in a different tab than the base does (save/reset are per-tab, so that would be ambiguous).
